description.value:
You have discovered ways to manipulate elemental energy in dynamic ways, including adapting more nuanced kinetic shapes, either temporary or persistent.

Elemental Infusions. You gain two elemental infusions of your choice. A list of the available options can be found on the Optional Features page. When you gain certain kineticist levels, you gain additional infusions of your choice.

Additionally, when you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the infusions you know and replace it with another infusion that you could learn at that level.

If an elemental infusion has prerequisites, you must meet them to learn it. You can learn the infusion at the same time that you meet its prerequisites. A level prerequisite refers to your level in this class.

Some infusions modify your kinetic shape. There are modifications for your kinetic blast and kinetic blade, and kinetic shape effects. You can only apply one one shape modification and one shape effect to the same use of a kinetic shape.

Kinesis Points. You have 2 kinesis points, which are used to power some of your elemental infusions. You gain one additional point every time you level up, to a maximum of 20 at level 20.

You can never have more kinesis points than shown on the table for your level. You regain all spent kinesis points when you finish a Long Rest.

Kinetic Reserves. You gain the following ways to spend your kinesis points.

  • Kinetic Enhancement. When you make an Ability Check, you can spend 1 kinesis point to gain Advantage on the check.
  • Kinetic Shield. When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can spend 1 kinesis point and use your Reaction to grant yourself Resistance against that instance of the damage.
